reference: Prior Woo224 candidate acb463fbe3c7d258695a5ae0c3a50e5af61affa50e848de26c270c727a7e117c, plus the retained original release.
diagnosed: Review all 36 previously severe predictions among HDF source fresh and all 13 previously good predictions among the 37 AFruitDB author mild test photos, with controls. These and all former evaluation sets are diagnostic or retrospective; never use their pixels as grading training examples.
fit: Train/dev from existing allowed public data. Exclude all HDF fresh and all HDF sources from final fitting because previously held-out fruit may reappear in edits and rotations. Group new splits by photographed fruit or conservatively by session/scene. The 44 AF location-reviewed images must all be members of the original training split. Empty local annotations are unknown.
development: Evaluate candidates with fixed argmax on the same AF 57 whole and detected crops and the new source development groups. Select by developmental constraints on good retention, mild recall and severe release without examining new test images or producing new historical predictions. Compare learned shared-backbone spatial marks to the grounded whole-image parent. Prefer the simpler candidate on equal measurements.
field: After locking one checkpoint, run all 110 historical AFruitDB photos at long edge 1280, all historical FruitLife/PennState/HDF panels, and the new grouped reserved photos. Reconcile every original 49 case plus surviving, newly introduced and unresolved errors. Classify all outcomes with fixed argmax. Never choose another checkpoint from this review.
consider_for_default: Compared to the prior Woo candidate, AF auto mild correct should exceed 14/37, AF good correct at least 39/56, AF severe-to-good 0/17 and severe correct at least 3/17. HDF fresh-to-severe should decrease, correctly good at least 28/69, and HDF source rot-to-good should not increase beyond 4/200. Track any confidently severe fruit sent to good on the newly reserved set and on the small Penn State panel. Also report previously correct apples that changed. The old default remains available even if these criteria pass.
timing: 20 predecoded AFruitDB images, 5 warmups per mode, 30 cycles (600 frames). Retain both previous maturity instance and visible defect networks, classify detected fruits and render overlays. Report mean, P95, FPS for camera-size 1280 frames and source 4K plus CPU resize. Also time known-single-fruit so grading actually runs on every frame.
